title: Corpse Run, Part 2
description: Corpse Run, Part 2 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Jerome's Bones

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Search through Upper Shadow's Embrace for Jerome Lester's corpses and loot them. Bring anything with his name on it to Jerome in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerome's Bones

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Corpse Run, Part 3

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Search through Upper Shadow's Embrace for Jerome Lester's corpses and loot them. Bring anything with his name on it to Jerome in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Bringing me back my razzin' frazzin' gloves didn't work--I'm still dead. Anyway, who dies *outside* of a dungeon? Only Jerome Lester, Royal Gravedigger, apparently.

...I need me a new plan. Hm. A Dungeon Runner's armor is like a second skin, right? Maybe I need *all* my armor back before I can get back into my *real* skin? Go search through the rest of Upper Shadow's Embrace for other corpses of mine. Bring me back any head, shoulder, and body armor of mine that you find.

Turn-in:

What kept ya? Hm, found more of my gear, didja? I guess everything might be a little loose since I lost weight.

Objectives:

  • Jerome Lester's Helmet ×1
  • Jerome Lester's Spaulders ×1
  • Jerome Lester's Suit of Armor ×1

Level range: 45–100
